text:
Priya Nair: FYI weve got an auth/routing regression impacting some EU onboarding flows. Webhook delivery and the initial embedding/index step are failing for a cohort of trial and SMB customers. Eng is looking at it now. Need comms and renewal triage.

Alex Kim: How many tenants and which ones are on renewal timelines?

Priya Nair: Roughly 38 tenants affected, I have a subset of 7 with renewals within 60d. DMing the list to Nadia + CSM leads.

Sam Torres: Can we offer a temporary hosted fallback to complete onboarding? Whats the data movement/legal story?

Priya Nair: Eng says fallback is technically feasible but requires explicit customer consent to route onboarding data through hosted infra. Well need an opt-in checkbox and to offer credits for the disruption.

Nadia Patel: For renewal-risk accounts: escalate to high-touch outreach, offer a live enablement session, and include an SLA credit or trial extension. Ill lead renewals comms.

Priya Nair: Draft technical notice (send immediately):
Hi <Name>,
Were investigating an issue affecting webhook ingest and first-time embedding runs for a small number of EU onboarding customers. Symptoms: webhook retries, 401/502 errors, and delayed index availability.
Mitigation options: 1) opt-in to a temporary hosted fallback so we can finish onboarding immediately, or 2) pause and retry once weve fixed the routing. Were also applying a service credit for impacted jobs.
Please reply to confirm your preference. Well follow up with an RCA within 72 hours.
Thanks,
<CS rep>

Priya Nair: Draft business-facing note (for renewals/execs):
Hi <Name>,
Were reaching out because a limited onboarding issue may have delayed your initial index availability. Were prioritizing your account: offering a live enablement session, a credit to cover lost throughput, and daily updates until resolved. If youre in renewal discussions, Im happy to jump on a call to review any impact.
Best,
<CS Lead>

Alex Kim: Add a one-liner in the business note: "We will extend trial/credit time to offset lost onboarding days"  helps reduce churn.

Sam Torres: Ill create the one-click opt-in flow and short rollback doc. Link to include for affected customers.

Priya Nair: Opt-in consent copy: 
[I consent to temporarily route my onboarding requests and associated payloads to Redwood-hosted inference to complete onboarding. I understand this is time-limited and covered by a credit.]

LegalBot: Reviewed credit language; you can offer up to 2 weeks equivalent trial/usage credit without further approvals.

Nadia Patel: Action items: 1) Send tech template to all affected now, 2) flag the 7 renewal-risk tenants and start 1:1 outreach, 3) include opt-in link in tech message, 4) schedule enablement sessions and record attendance in the tracking sheet (columns: renewal_risk, opt_in, session_scheduled, credit_applied).

Priya Nair: Agreed. Ill send tech messages in the next 20 minutes. Nadia please prioritize the 7.

Sam Torres: Opt-in URL created: https://console.redwood.ai/fallback/optin/20260430 (consent checkbox + brief privacy note). Ill add a rollback toggle for CSMs.

Alex Kim: Sent technical message batch at 2026-04-30T09:32Z to cohort. Will paste delivery log after follow-up.

Priya Nair: Legal signoff confirmed at 2026-04-30T09:55Z. Business notes queued for the renewals.

IncidentBot: Incident ID IND-2026-04-EU-ONB created. Status: investigating. ETA mitigation plan: T+4h.

Nadia Patel: Ive scheduled 3 enablement sessions this week and reached out to the 7 renewal accounts. Will log results in the sheet and follow-up with a post-outreach feedback survey.

Priya Nair: Final update: provisional credits applied to renewal accounts and opt-in uptake at ~50% so far. Will post RCA draft when eng confirms root cause. Last update: 1714209100.
